id: 22_Stay Safe In The Lab Prevent Fires, Slips, And Falls! Training Course
title: 防火灾、防滑倒、防劳损
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/22_Stay Safe In The Lab Prevent Fires, Slips, And Falls! Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/22_Stay Safe In The Lab Prevent Fires, Slips, And Falls! Training Course/src.py

points.K5: 火大或没把握，马上报警
points.K9: 腰颈手腕疼，别不当回事
points.K10: 停、伸展、调工位，反复疼就医
points.S1: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室里，身后墙上有灭火器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a lab with a fire extinguisher on the wall behind and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：防火灾、防滑倒、防劳损。

shots.scene: 阿杰端着烧杯小跑，地上有一摊水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hurries across the lab holding a beaker, heading toward a puddle of water on the floor.
shots.narration: 阿杰端着烧杯小跑，没看见地上的水。

shots.scene: 小研在后面喊，伸手指向地面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls out from behind and points at the puddle, but he is already stepping into it.
shots.narration: 小研喊他看脚下，可已经晚了一步。

shots.scene: 火焰、滑倒的小人、弯腰的小人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a flame, a person slipping on a wet floor, and a person holding an aching back. No people.
shots.narration: 物理事故，主要有三类。

shots.scene: 台面上冒起小火，小研大声提醒大家
shots.prompt_en: A small fire flares up on a bench; the female graduate student raises her arm and calls out to everyone.
shots.narration: 起火了，先喊人、先撤人，别犹豫。

shots.scene: 其他同学沿疏散箭头走向安全出口
shots.prompt_en: Other students walk quickly along an evacuation arrow toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 无关的人，马上离开。

shots.scene: 小研站在门口方向，背后是出口，面前一小团火
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands with the exit door behind her, facing a small fire on the bench.
shots.narration: 人撤开了，又是小火，再用灭火器。

shots.scene: 四步图示：提起、拔销、握管、压把
shots.prompt_en: Four-step diagram of using a fire extinguisher: lift it, pull the safety pin, hold the hose, press the handle. No people.
shots.narration: 提起、拔销、握住喷管、压下压把。

shots.scene: 喷口对准火焰根部，左右扫射
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher nozzle aimed at the base of a small flame, sweeping left and right with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 对准火焰根部，左右扫。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现六个火灾类别图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside six fire class icons: wood, liquid drop, gas cylinder, metal block, electric plug and frying pan.
shots.narration: 火灾分好几类。

shots.scene: 木材纸张燃烧、溶剂燃烧两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: burning paper and wood, and a burning solvent spill. No people.
shots.narration: 纸木是A类，易燃液体是B类。

shots.scene: 带电设备着火图标，旁边断电开关
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burning instrument with its plug, next to a power switch being turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备着火，先断电再扑救。

shots.scene: 金属着火图标旁，水桶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burning metal block next to a bucket of water crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 活泼金属着火，不能用水。

shots.scene: 灭火器标签上的类别图标和火灾类型对上
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher with blank label showing class icons, matched by arrows to fire type icons. No people.
shots.narration: 看清灭火器适用类别，用对才有效。

shots.section_title: 火大或没把握，马上报警
shots.scene: 火势变大，小研退出门外
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows larger and the female graduate student backs out through the door and closes it.
shots.narration: 火大了，或者没把握，别冒险。
overlay: 火大或没把握，马上报警

shots.section_title: 火大或没把握，马上报警
shots.scene: 小研拨打电话，旁边报告图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call outside; beside her are icons of a fire truck, a lab, a department building and a security shield.
shots.narration: 立即拨打119，报告老师和保卫处。

shots.scene: 火灭后，小研检查余烬，旁边放着灭火器
shots.prompt_en: After the fire is out, the female graduate student checks the bench for hot spots with the extinguisher still at hand.
shots.narration: 火灭了，还要检查会不会复燃。

shots.scene: 冒烟的余烬图标被打叉，凉透的台面打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of smoldering embers crossed out with a red X, and a cool clean bench with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 确认没有余火，再离开。

shots.scene: 阿杰滑倒坐在地上，表情吃痛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has slipped and sits on the lab floor with a pained expression.
shots.narration: 摔倒了，别马上跳起来。

shots.scene: 阿杰停下来，摸摸手腕和膝盖
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses and gently checks his wrist and knee.
shots.narration: 先停一下，看看哪里受伤。

shots.scene: 小研蹲下询问，拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student crouches beside him to ask, and picks up her phone.
shots.narration: 疼得厉害或头晕，马上求助。

shots.scene: 阿杰扶着实验台慢慢站起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds the edge of a sturdy bench and stands up slowly.
shots.narration: 没事的话，扶着东西慢慢起来。

shots.scene: 小研用拖把拖干地面，立起小心地滑标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student mops up the water and sets up a slippery floor warning sign.
shots.narration: 把地面弄干，别让别人再摔。

shots.section_title: 腰颈手腕疼，别不当回事
shots.scene: 小研长时间伏案，腰、颈、手腕出现红点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hunches over the bench for hours; red strain marks glow on her neck, back and wrist.
shots.narration: 重复干活，腰颈手腕会悄悄疼起来。
overlay: 腰颈手腕疼，别不当回事

shots.section_title: 腰颈手腕疼，别不当回事
shots.scene: 忽视疼痛继续干的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person ignoring a sore wrist and keeping on working, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 疼了，别硬撑。

shots.section_title: 停、伸展、调工位，反复疼就医
shots.scene: 小研停下，伸展肩颈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops working and stretches her neck and shoulders.
shots.narration: 停一停，伸展一下，再调工位。
overlay: 停、伸展、调工位，反复疼就医

shots.section_title: 停、伸展、调工位，反复疼就医
shots.scene: 小研向老周反映，然后走向医院
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tells the older man about her recurring pain, then heads toward a clinic building with a red cross sign.
shots.narration: 反复疼，告诉老师，及时就医。

shots.scene: 空白的消防规范文件和灭火器、出口标志
shots.prompt_en: A blank fire safety regulation binder next to a fire extinguisher sign and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室防火，有国家法规和学校规定。

shots.scene: 抄近路的箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A shortcut arrow crossed out with a red X next to a fire icon. No people.
shots.narration: 消防上偷工减料，代价太大。

shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上的疏散平面图讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at an evacuation floor plan on the wall while students listen.
shots.narration: 熟悉本楼的疏散图和应急预案。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻看空白的实验室安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank lab safety handbook carefully.
shots.narration: 安全规范和学校规定，都要读一读。

shots.section_title: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚
shots.scene: 身上着火的人奔跑的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person with burning clothes running, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 衣服着火，千万别跑。
overlay: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚

shots.section_title: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚
shots.scene: 停、倒、滚三步图示
shots.prompt_en: Three-step diagram: a person stops, drops to the floor and rolls with hands covering the face. No people.
shots.narration: 停下、躺倒、捂脸打滚。

shots.section_title: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚
shots.scene: 安全淋浴标志和淋浴装置
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower sign above a lab safety shower with water pouring down. No people.
shots.narration: 附近有安全淋浴，马上去冲。

shots.scene: 墙上的灭火毯盒子
shots.prompt_en: A red fire blanket pouch mounted on a lab wall. No people.
shots.narration: 小范围着火，可以用灭火毯。

shots.scene: 灭火毯盖住台面上燃烧的小烧杯
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands lay a fire blanket over a small burning beaker on a bench, smothering the flame. No people.
shots.narration: 拉出灭火毯，整块盖住火焰。

shots.scene: 灭火毯盖着，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: The fire blanket stays in place over the beaker with an hourglass icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 盖好别急着掀开，等它冷却。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾擦干台下洒的水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes up a small spill of water on the floor with paper towels right away.
shots.narration: 地上洒了水或试剂，马上处理。

shots.scene: 实验室里奔跑的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person running in a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不奔跑。

shots.scene: 拖鞋凉鞋被打叉，包脚防滑鞋打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sandals and slippers crossed out with a red X, and closed-toe non-slip shoes with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 穿包脚、防滑的鞋。

shots.scene: 通道上的纸箱和电线被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of boxes and a trailing cable on a lab walkway, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通道不堆杂物，不拖电线。

shots.scene: 站在转椅上够高处试剂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing on a rolling chair to reach a high shelf, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高处取物，不站转椅和凳子。

shots.scene: 小研站在稳固的踏步凳上取物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a sturdy step stool with handrails to reach a high shelf.
shots.narration: 用稳固的踏凳，一手扶稳。

shots.scene: 重物放在货架下层
shots.prompt_en: Heavy bottles placed on the lowest shelf and light boxes on the top shelf, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 重的东西，放在下层。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现撤离、灭火器、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an evacuation arrow, a fire extinguisher and a telephone.
shots.narration: 起火先撤人，小火才扑，火大就报警。

shots.scene: 停倒滚和灭火毯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of stop-drop-roll and a fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 身上着火就地滚，小火可用灭火毯。

shots.scene: 干燥地面和防滑鞋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dry floor and non-slip shoes. No people.
shots.narration: 地面保持干，走路别跑。

shots.scene: 伸展的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person stretching at a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 累了伸展，反复疼要就医。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab doorway.
shots.narration: 防火防滑防劳损，下次见！
